newsitem.title: UK: Woolwich conversion approved by regulator.
newsitem.headline: Woolwich conversion approved by regulator.

text.p: The Woolwich Building Society said on Friday that the Building Societies Commission has approved its planned conversion and stock exchange flotation which will now go ahead on July 7.

The Woolwich, one of four mutually-owned British building societies coming to the stock market this year, said it will send out statements to its members detailing their share allocations between May 28 and June 6.
It said 2.5 million members will qualify for an allocation of free shares.

In common with other converting societies, Woolwich is offering members a free share sale service but chief executive John Stewart said in a statement that he hoped the majority will decide to retain their holding.
